{"id":"JMAP-v9py.15","title":"Layer E: Implement draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 (new jmap-chat-federation-{types,server,client} crates)","description":"Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 at ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/.

NOT WORKED in the JMAP-v9py compliance sweep; filed for a later session.

Capability: extends urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat with a "role" field (\"owner\" | \"peer\"). No new capability URI of its own.

## What needs to land

- New crates jmap-chat-federation-types, jmap-chat-federation-server, jmap-chat-federation-client (or extension modules on the existing chat-* crates, decision pending)
- 5 REQUIRED Peer/* methods: Peer/deliver, Peer/receipt, Peer/typing, Peer/retract, Peer/groupUpdate
- 3 OPTIONAL Peer/* methods: Peer/subscribePresence, Peer/unsubscribePresence, Peer/presence
- Extended ChatContact: serverUrl, directAddress (untrusted)
- Outbound senderMsgId translation rules (server stores receiver-id, must translate to sender-id for outbound replyTo/threadRootId)
- 10-step new-message validation procedure on Peer/deliver (auth, identity verification, blob fetch with SSRF guard, mention bounds, etc.)
- Direct-chat simultaneous-initiation race resolution (min(X,Y) lex)
- Session-object extension fields (ownerUserId, ownerDirectAddress)

## Estimated scope

- 3 new crates, ~2000-3000 LOC across types/server/client/tests
- Multi-week effort; multiple focused sessions
- Depends on the rest of the JMAP-v9py compliance sweep landing first (so chat-types is stable)

## Open architecture questions

- Place Peer/* methods in chat-server-extension or new crate?
- How does CallerCtx model "remote peer" vs "local user"?
- Blob fetch with SSRF guard: kit hook signature, or deployment-only?
- mTLS / OAuth client-credentials authentication: kit doesn't ship transport, so this is deployment","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"epic","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-05-12T23:37:30Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-05-12T23:37:30Z","metadata":{},"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"","depends_on_id":"","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-05-12T16:37:29Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
